description: This file defines the Response class in the Opencart system library, responsible for managing HTTP response headers, output, and redirection logic within the application.
external_files: header() and related functions (built-in PHP functions)

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Class responsible for managing HTTP response headers, output content, compression, and redirection in the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Add an HTTP header to the response.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieve all headers that have been added.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirect to a specified URL with an optional status code.

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Set the compression level for output compression.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Set the content output for the response.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compress data using gzip if supported and enabled.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Render the output to the client with appropriate headers.
